label: Compiler interface repair LeaveAdminPage
instruction: Fix only TypeScript/import/library interface errors in the existing file, returning its complete raw source. Remove unused Next router import/variable and unused http import. Add useState, named PageHeader, errorMessage and getConfiguration/saveConfiguration/getRecords plus type Configuration imports from existing paths. Mantine7 uses Textarea, Table.Thead/Table.Tbody/Table.Tr/Table.Th/Table.Td, Group justify, LoadingOverlay overlayProps={{blur:2}}, Alert color="red", Table highlightOnHover. ReactQuery5 useQuery({queryKey:[...],queryFn:existing_callback}); map result property names with aliases isLoading:isLoadingRecords etc. Annotate mutationFn(newData:Configuration). Adapt missing state setters to typed useState<Record<string,any>[]>([]) for history and notifications, removing existing const arrays. Preserve payloads, HTTP calls, field assumptions (record.date/details, notification.title/description/status), dialogs and effects; do not correct business logic or audit requirements. Remove unused imports required by noUnusedLocals. Do not rewrite or add features. No workflow/business fixes. Close all JSX.
